title: KeePassXC: free 1Password alternative
caption:
1Password charges $3.99/month to keep your passwords safe. KeePassXC does it for free 🔑

✅ Password generator for strong, random passwords
✅ Auto-Type and browser integration fill in your logins
✅ Stores two-factor (TOTP) codes, imports from 1Password and Bitwarden
✅ Encrypted offline database, no subscription, no tracking

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ There's no built-in cloud sync and no official phone app. Your database is a single file, so keep it in any cloud folder and open it on your phone with compatible apps like KeePassDX (Android).
